lines.en: My new project never showed up in the list.

lines.ko: 이제 제 프로젝트 목록을 직접 훑습니다.
lines.en: Now it walks through my own project list directly.
Once I tag a project, it appears within 30 minutes.
I do not type in the public address either.
It gets found and attached on its own.

lines.ko: 방금 만든 프로젝트는 검색에 늦게 뜹니다.
lines.en: A freshly created project takes a while to show up in search.

lines.ko: 오늘 밤 자동 실행 기록을 확인합니다.
lines.en: Tonight I will check the record of the automatic run.
lines.art: a small flashlight beam sweeping across a dark shelf of sealed boxes at night

lines.en: One spot I had to touch by hand is gone.

captions.en: Spent a day finding out why my new project never appeared in the list. Now tagging it is enough: it shows up within 30 minutes and the public address is found automatically.
